title: @eddacraft/nxrust:add-rust-reference
description: Wire a JS/TS project to a sibling Rust crate with the D-009 cross-language test-seam contract: explicitly override the JS `test.dependsOn` so a JS test never triggers a transitive cargo build (ISS-001). The kind-agnostic core that `add-napi` / `add-wasm-reference` wrap.

project.description: The JS/TS project that consumes the Rust crate.
project.x-prompt: Which JS/TS project consumes the Rust crate?

crate.x-prompt: Which Rust crate does it consume?

consumesArtifactAtBuildTime.description: Retain the inherited `^build` on the JS `test` target. Only correct when the JS build imports the Rust artefact at TS build time (e.g. a WASM module bundled into webpack/Vite). A NAPI `.node` is loaded at require time, so leave this false.
